name: How do I choose the right contractor for my exterior renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my exterior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the right contractor involves several key steps. Look for licensed and insured professionals with a strong portfolio of similar projects. Check references and read reviews from past clients. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining all costs, materials, and timelines. Good communication is crucial; choose a contractor who is responsive and transparent. Don't base your decision solely on price; prioritize experience, reliability, and clear understanding of your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on licensing, insurance, portfolio, references, detailed estimates, and clear communication, not just price.
